seeds.source_anchor_quote_en: "the after one was placed over the turbine hatch and was used as a ventilator"
seeds.external_lens_identity: Costly signaling / conspicuous consumption in transport design (Veblen; maritime liner prestige signaling)
seeds.mechanism_claim_zh: 第四个“烟囱”并非主要排烟构件，而是把功能外形借给品牌与信誉信号：用高成本、远距离可见的轮廓向乘客传达“更大、更快、更可靠”。这不是装饰换名，而是市场信号机制在工程外形中的嵌入。
seeds.reread_delta_zh: 重读后，这句不再只是结构说明；它暴露出船体可见外形与真实功能并不一一对应，说明部分设计是在服务乘客认知和竞争地位，而不只是热工需要。
source_leads: Thorstein Veblen, The Theory of the Leisure Class (conspicuous consumption / status signaling)
Mark Chirnside, works on Olympic-class liners and the fourth funnel's ventilating role
Maritime history references on dummy funnels in transatlantic liner competition

seeds.source_anchor_quote_en: "The uptakes ... were united immediately above the water-tight bulkhead which separated the boiler rooms."
seeds.external_lens_identity: Common-mode failure via barrier penetration; tight coupling in accident theory (Perrow)
seeds.mechanism_claim_zh: 这里的关键不是“有水密舱壁”，而是本应隔离的锅炉舱在舱壁上方被烟道重新耦合。安全屏障被服务系统穿透后，隔离从“绝对分段”变成“条件分段”，引入共因失效路径。
seeds.reread_delta_zh: 重读后，水密舱壁不再能被直观理解为完整隔断；原文其实在暗示，功能系统为了效率跨越了分隔边界，削弱了读者对“舱室彼此独立”的默认想象。
source_leads: Charles Perrow, Normal Accidents (tight coupling / complex interactions)
Naval architecture discussions of watertight bulkhead penetrations and trunking
Technical histories of large steamships' uptake arrangements across boiler-room divisions

seeds.source_anchor_quote_en: "All overhead discharge from the circulating pumps, ballast pumps, bilge pumps, etc., were below the deep load line, but above the light line."
seeds.external_lens_identity: State-dependent safety margin in naval architecture (load line / freeboard / downflooding risk)
seeds.mechanism_claim_zh: 这些排出口的安全性取决于船舶吃水状态：同一开口在轻载时高于水面、在深载时低于水面。机制不是静态“安全/不安全”，而是由载荷条件切换的风险边界。
seeds.reread_delta_zh: 重读后，这句变成一条“条件安全”信息：设备布置并非独立成立，而是绑定在载重线制度与浮态假设上，提醒读者不要把结构位置当作固定意义。
source_leads: Samuel Plimsoll and the historical load line regime
Standard naval architecture texts on freeboard and downflooding
SOLAS / merchant ship load line discussions of openings relative to load conditions

seeds.source_anchor_quote_en: "Silent blow-offs from the main steam pipes were connected direct to both condensers."
seeds.external_lens_identity: Closed-cycle steam economy in Rankine-system practice; nuisance-abatement by condenser routing
seeds.mechanism_claim_zh: “silent blow-off”直连冷凝器，说明放汽不是简单排空，而是被并入冷凝回收与降噪路径。它把乘客舒适、蒸汽损失控制、机舱热力循环连成一个隐藏的系统机制。
seeds.reread_delta_zh: 重读后，这句不只是附件清单；它显示蒸汽船上的许多“舒适性”或“安静”效果并非独立特性，而是通过热力系统集成实现的副产物。
source_leads: Marine engineering textbooks on condensers and auxiliary steam exhaust arrangements
Rankine-cycle practice references on routing relief/blow-off steam to condensers
Early 20th-century steamship engineering manuals discussing silent blow-off systems
